activities.title: Design: lock/hide controls — round 1
activities.body:
Priya
  Today at 10:12 AM
Hey team — first pass on SFDC field lock/hide for contract create is in Figma:
https://www.figma.com/file/demo/sfdc-field-lock-r1

Open questions:
1. Do we lock fields after SFDC sync, or also allow admins to unlock per template?
2. Hide vs lock — should hidden fields still submit values in the background?

@design @product would love eyes before we go further.

Anagh
  Today at 10:28 AM
Looks clean. Prefer: hidden fields still sync (read-only payload) so we don't break mappings. Unlock should be admin-only + audit logged.

Deepti
  Today at 10:41 AM
+1 on audit. Also can we show a small "locked from Salesforce" badge on the field label? CS keeps getting asked why they can't edit.

Priya
  Today at 10:55 AM
Badge noted — will add in r2. Locking after sync + admin unlock path. Threading updates here.

activities.title: Design back-and-forth — round 2 revisions
activities.body:
Priya
  Yesterday at 3:04 PM
SFDC lock/hide r2 up: https://www.figma.com/file/demo/sfdc-field-lock-r2

Changes from r1 thread:
• "Locked from Salesforce" badge on locked fields
• Admin unlock flow + confirmation modal
• Hidden fields still submit mapped values (ghosted in UI)
• Empty-state when *all* mapped fields are locked

@Anagh @Deepti — does this unblock BE/FE split?

Anagh
  Yesterday at 3:22 PM
Yes. One tweak: unlock should be per-field, not whole form. Otherwise legal can't fix a single bad mapping without opening everything.

Deepti
  Yesterday at 3:31 PM
Agreed on per-field. Also please note the Ocrolus ask — they want this on create *and* edit. Can we scope create-only for v1 and call out edit as follow-up?

Priya
  Yesterday at 3:40 PM
Per-field unlock in. Create-only for v1, edit = follow-up ticket. Updating Figma now — consider design approved pending that.

Anagh
  Yesterday at 3:48 PM
Approved from eng side. I'll cut BE tasks off this.

activities.title: BE spec is getting done
activities.body:
Anagh
  Today at 11:05 AM
Update on SFDC field lock/hide — BE spec is getting done.

Covered:
• Field policy model (lock | hide | editable) keyed by SFDC mapping id + template
• Sync behavior: locked after inbound SFDC sync; admin per-field unlock with audit event
• Hidden fields still included in create payload (not rendered)
• API: GET/PUT `/templates/{id}/field-policies`
• Create-contract path honors policies; edit-contract deferred (follow-up)

Open for FE:
• Badge + unlock modal copy from Figma r2
• Empty state when all fields locked

Doc: https://docs.internal/clm/sfdc-field-lock-be-spec
CC: @Priya @Deepti @pt

Will ping when PR for policy APIs is up.

activities.title: Design: email in signature block
activities.body:
Jamie
  Monday at 2:15 PM
Working design for "Email ID in signature blocks" — early draft:
https://www.figma.com/file/demo/signature-email-field

Questions for CS/product:
1. Is email required when the block is present, or optional?
2. Should it prefill from the counterparty contact if we have one?
3. Ocrolus / Twelve Labs / Tennr all asked — any template-level toggle or always-on?

Shubham
  Monday at 2:41 PM
Optional field, prefill when we have a contact email, template toggle default OFF so existing packs don't change behavior overnight.

Jamie
  Monday at 3:02 PM
Perfect — updating frames. Will share r2 tomorrow.

activities.title: Design back-and-forth — validation + placement
activities.body:
Jamie
  Tuesday at 11:20 AM
r2 for signature email field: https://www.figma.com/file/demo/signature-email-field-r2

• Optional field under name in the block
• Prefill from counterparty contact
• Template toggle "Include email in signature block"
• Inline validation (basic email format)

Shubham
  Tuesday at 11:48 AM
Looks good. Can we allow multiple emails (CC signers) or keep single for v1?

Vanshika
  Tuesday at 12:05 PM
Please keep single for v1 — multi-signer email is a separate ask and will balloon scope. Also move the field *below* title so print layout doesn't collide with the stamp.

Jamie
  Tuesday at 12:22 PM
Single email, moved below title. Marking design ready for eng.

Shubham
  Tuesday at 12:30 PM
Ack — picking up FE tomorrow once BE adds the field on the block schema.

activities.title: BE: signature block email field landed
activities.body:
Shubham
  Today at 4:10 PM
BE update — email field on signature blocks is in.

• Schema: `signatureBlocks[].email` (nullable string)
• Template flag: `includeEmailInSignatureBlock`
• Prefill hook from counterparty contact when flag is on
• Validation on create/send: format only if present

FE can wire the Figma r2 control. Tracking ticket CLM-1842.
CC: @Jamie @Vanshika @pt

activities.title: Design: version delete + purge confirm
activities.body:
Priya
  Last Wednesday at 9:40 AM
First pass on version deletion / storage purge:
https://www.figma.com/file/demo/version-deletion

Flow:
1. Version history → ⋮ → Delete version
2. Confirm modal with "This cannot be undone" + storage reclaimed estimate
3. Cannot delete current/published version

Acme + Globex both hitting storage caps — want this ASAP.

@product @eng thoughts?

Pooja
  Last Wednesday at 10:05 AM
CS loves this. Please add: who deleted + when in the remaining history (audit line), otherwise renewals get messy.

Anagh
  Last Wednesday at 10:19 AM
Agree on audit. Also soft-delete for 7 days before hard purge? Or hard delete immediately for storage relief?

Priya
  Last Wednesday at 10:35 AM
Hard delete for v1 (storage is the pain). Audit line stays on the parent doc. Updating Figma.

activities.title: Design back-and-forth — bulk purge
activities.body:
Priya
  Last Thursday at 1:15 PM
r2: https://www.figma.com/file/demo/version-deletion-r2

• Hard delete + audit line on parent
• Block delete of current version
• New: multi-select old versions → "Delete selected" for storage cleanup

Pooja
  Last Thursday at 1:42 PM
Bulk is what Acme asked for — nice. Can we default-sort oldest first so they don't accidentally nuke recent drafts?

Anagh
  Last Thursday at 1:55 PM
Yes please. Also cap bulk at 50/version page to keep the API sane.

Priya
  Last Thursday at 2:08 PM
Oldest-first + 50 cap. Design locked from my side.

Anagh
  Last Thursday at 2:12 PM
BE will start with single-delete API this sprint; bulk next. Thread for status.

activities.title: BE spec is getting done
activities.body:
Anagh
  Today at 9:50 AM
Version deletion — BE spec is getting done.

• `DELETE /documents/{id}/versions/{versionId}` — hard delete, forbids current version
• Audit event on parent: actor, version label, bytes reclaimed
• Bulk endpoint drafted but deferred to next sprint (max 50)
• Storage quota recalc async after delete

Spec: https://docs.internal/clm/version-deletion-be
CC: @Priya @Pooja @pt

activities.title: Design: Legal Owner / Reviewer question type
activities.body:
Jamie
  Friday at 4:05 PM
Intake form — User question type for Legal Owner / Legal Reviewer draft:
https://www.figma.com/file/demo/legal-user-assignment

• Typeahead of workspace users (legal role filter optional)
• Required vs optional per question config
• Shows avatar + email in the filled state

Versant is the loudest ask here.

Vanshika

Can we allow "assign later" empty state that still lets the form submit? Some deals don't know reviewer at intake.

Jamie
  Friday at 4:40 PM
Yes — optional by default; admins can mark required on the template. Updating copy.

activities.title: Design back-and-forth — role filter
activities.body:
Jamie

Executed-copy upload restriction — design draft:
